reply_text: Pellow, not Pellucid. The lamp delivery at door 6 was on Pellow Home Living, the renamed Covey & Lark Retail account. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, and both use the code PHL, which is why you and Kwame got tangled. I've posted that answer in #coastal-team with your name on it, based on the Feb 17 thread there.
